The SG2002/CV181x uses a **Synopsys DesignWare GMAC v3.50a (DWMAC1000)** with a built-in **CVitek EPHY** connected via RMII. All GMAC offsets are relative to base address **0x04070000**.

| `SG2000_EPHY_BASE` | `0x03009000` | Built-in EPHY base |
| `SG2000_EPHY_TOP` | `0x03009800` | EPHY top control register |
| `SG2000_CLKGEN_BASE` | `0x03002000` | Clock generator base |

### 2. Clock & Reset Registers (at 0x03002000 / 0x03003000)

| Define | Offset/ID | Description |

| `RST_ETH0` | bit 12 | Main GMAC reset line |
